claims.label: HYPOTHESIS — not used in verdict
claims.claim: TSC1 loss disinhibits mTORC1 signaling, which enhances IL-2 protein translation despite reduced mRNA, via post-transcriptional upregulation of translation initiation [2, 3].
claims.distinguishing_experiment: Measure IL-2 protein half-life (pulse-chase with radiolabel or cycloheximide block) in TSC1-depleted T cells: if protein is stabilized (longer half-life), hypothesis 1 (post-transcriptional buffering) is favored; if half-life is unchanged or shortened but translation rate (ribosome density on IL2 mRNA by polysome profiling) is elevated, hypothesis 2 (enhanced translation per mRNA) is favored.
